messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: Problem with instalation INLa
parts:
Using R-3.6? Otherwise, please upgrade and retry?

If you have already the INLA package install, you have to remove it by

remove.packages("INLA")

and then reinstall (due to Win-issues)

H
